tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: text, text-mut.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar and the fill of inputs, selects and toggles-off.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, drawers and tables. Text on it: text, text-mut.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Inset panels inside a card: command preview, log tail, code blocks, key/value editors.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: bg-row
tokens.usage: Selected or striped table rows, the segmented control's active pill, kbd keys.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table rules, sidebar divider. Decorative, not a meaning-carrying mark.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, badges, toggle tracks.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Control border on hover. Meets 3:1 against bg-card in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg-card, bg-inset and bg-row (≥ 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-mut
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata (uptime, RSS, PID, table headers) on bg, bg-card and bg-inset (≥ 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Tertiary: placeholders, disabled labels, the MOCK badge. Fails 4.5:1 by design (Relay's value, kept exact); never the only carrier of information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber fill: the primary button, the starting-state dot, the memory meter above 80%. Text on it is on-accent, never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text or icon on bg, bg-card, bg-inset: 'starting' labels, warnings, pending relay state (≥ 5.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent-ink: warning boxes, the starting badge.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Relay fill: the connected pill dot in dark, link underline, focus ring in dark.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Relay and links as text or icon on bg, bg-card, bg-inset: 'registered', aliases, the Relay pill (≥ 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cyan-ink: relay badges, info boxes.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Ready fill for large marks in dark; always paired with a label.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Ready and healthy as text, dot or ✓ on bg, bg-card, bg-inset (≥ 5.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind green-ink: the ready badge, success toasts.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Failed fill for large marks in dark and the memory meter above 92%; always paired with a label.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Failed, error and destructive as text, dot or ✗ on bg, bg-card, bg-inset (≥ 5.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind red-ink: error boxes, the destructive button, highlighted error log lines.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Router fill for large marks in dark; always paired with the 'router' label.

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Router instances and special states as text or badge on bg, bg-card, bg-inset (≥ 6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind purple-ink: the router kind badge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every control. Meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim behind dialogs and the mobile nav sheet.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and instance names (the name itself is set in mono-name).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No models running. lcpp is idle and using almost nothing.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, form labels, toasts.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, secondary card metadata.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, table headers and nav group titles. Always uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Endpoints, ports, PIDs, paths, flags, command previews and numbers.

styles.name: mono-badge
styles.usage: Badges and chips: params, kinds, states, aliases.

styles.name: log
styles.sample: main: server is listening on http://127.0.0.1:7072
styles.usage: Log tail lines and code snippets.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Large figures: idle memory on the empty state, the About block.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Cards pad space-4, dialogs space-6, badges space-1 × space-2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding, gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges and between inline controls; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, input padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, page gutter on desktop, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between view sections, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phones; empty-state top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, kbd keys, inset code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, drawers, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle tracks and thumbs, the Relay pill, the jump-to-latest pill.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers and the toast stack. Cards have no shadow: borders separate surfaces.
